description: 宽檐遮阳、内衬汗带、细密同心车线的冷白灰场图示风详情组

styleLock.direction: minimal cool-tone diagrammatic hat detail-page system
styleLock.backgroundSystem: 扁平冷白棚拍场为主，横向浅灰版面带分屏，允许一屏对角双色斜切；只用发丝细线做分隔，无渐变、无杂物、无堆叠场景
styleLock.lightingSystem: 明亮均匀的冷调棚拍光，左上约 40 度大面积柔光主光 + 右侧细补光，色温 6500K；悬浮产品下方一枚柔离身椭圆投影，落地产品必须有真实接触阴影；每屏只有一个光向，禁止平光与矛盾投影
styleLock.surfaceSystem: 织物缝制表面语言：帽檐同心车线行、车缝檐槽、内圈贴带与帽冠接缝，位置一律以参考图实际为准，不增不减
styleLock.typography: 单一现代几何无衬线族；每屏顶部一小字低不透明度拉丁 kicker 压在粗体中文主标之上，主标下一道发丝细线与三枚青色短竖条作分节标记；一切文案数值皆为占位符；禁衬线、手写、复古、卡通字
styleLock.iconSystem: 1.5pt 单色描边扁平图标与扁平图示笔触（环绕弧、光线折避箭头、上升气流箭头），仅用青蓝 #7FC6E8，等线宽，带小箭头端，无填充、无立体、无阴影
styleLock.presentationRules: 产品按真实比例稳定呈现，帽檐轮廓完整不裁切；同屏只放一枚产品（选色并列屏除外）；机位在整套里轮换，首屏与折光屏反向侧偏以避免重复；佩戴镜只用背影或下颌线以下裁切，不出现可识别面部；所有尺寸、颜色名、等级、文案一律占位
noDrift: no invented numbers or sun-protection ratings
no QR codes or membership badges
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent minimal cool-tone diagrammatic e-commerce detail-page visual system across the whole set; fixed palette of seamless studio white #FFFFFF, cool off-white page field #F4F5F6, light grey panel band #DDE0E2, near-black type #232527, mid-grey sub-type #8A8F94 and one cyan-blue diagram accent #7FC6E8, with the product's own colour always taken from the reference; cool neutral tone throughout, no warm cast; typography of one modern geometric sans-serif family only, a small low-opacity Latin kicker line sitting above a bold Chinese headline, one hairline rule and three short cyan vertical tick bars as section markers, all copy supplied as placeholders, no serif, no script, no retro or cartoon lettering; background system of flat near-white studio planes interrupted by light grey horizontal bands, one optional diagonal two-tone split, hairline dividers only, generous margins, no clutter, no gradients; lighting system of bright even cool studio light with a large soft key from upper-left at about 40 degrees and a thin fill on the shadow side, 6500K, one soft detached elliptical drop shadow under a floating product and a real contact shadow when it rests on a surface, one light direction per frame, never flat, never contradictory; surface language of stitched textile construction: concentric brim stitch rows, a stitched brim channel, an inner taping band and a crown seam exactly as placed on the reference; layout system of stacked vertical detail-page screens, rounded white cards inset on grey bands, italic numbered section labels, thin leader-line callouts, one two-panel comparison grid and one two-column label/value spec table ruled with hairlines; icon and diagram system of 1.5pt single-weight outline pictograms and flat diagram strokes only, an orbit arc, deflected ray arrows and rising airflow arrows drawn in #7FC6E8 with small arrowheads, flat, no 3D, no fill, no drop shadow; product shown at stable real-world scale with the brim silhouette complete and never clipped, one product per screen except a variant row, any wearer shown only as back view or cropped below the jaw so no face is identifiable, every measurement, colour name, grade and headline rendered as a placeholder; no colour palette changes, no warm colour cast, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no invented numbers, no readable brand marks, no QR codes, no membership or discount badges.

provenance.notes: 源为一张详情页长图切成的 11 片（panel-01 至 panel-11），逐片读图后合并同类镜、去掉重复分屏留白，得 12 镜。主体判读：11 片全部围绕同一顶棉质宽檐渔夫帽（卡其/米/黄/黑多色），无其它品类商品入镜，主体唯一，故为纯套。品类判定与源夹名不符：源夹「饰品装饰品」与文件名「小夕素材(59)」是素材站命名，均非 taxonomy 字符串；帽子作为穿戴配饰按库内既有惯例（空顶遮阳帽、钩编盆帽两条均已落在 珠宝饰品-配饰）归入 L1 珠宝饰品 / L2 配饰，未按 女装 或 运动户外 归类——源页眉的 Fashion 与 Style display 属模板套版词，不构成运动用途主张。已剥离：内嵌水印卡与站名文字、两处二维码、入会与全店免费类促销角标、进店扫码与价格话术、帽内灰色品牌织标与外圈彩色刺绣字样（模板一律不出现可读标识，负向清单已显式禁止）、规格表中的品牌字段取值（改为 {callout_*} 占位）。数值脱敏：防晒等级与 UPF、帽围、檐宽、材质百分比、色名一律占位，不编造。panel-08 至 panel-10 的图位在源片里即为空灰卡与空蓝药丸标签，只保留了版式语法（灰带上的白圆角卡与右下标签条、01/02/03 斜体编号左右交错的细节行），产品内容改由生成时注入。与库内 zhubaoshipin-nvshi-gouzhen-bianzhi-xidai-penmao（暖调日光、灰紫蓝实色块加白卡偏移细线框、手工织孔与系带蝴蝶尾）以及 zhubaoshipin-nvshi-kongding-dayan-zheyangmao（轻薄大檐空顶、冷调雾蓝浅场）差异：本款为闭顶圆冠下翻宽檐、无系带的中性棉质渔夫帽，视觉体系换成冷调近白棚拍场加横向浅灰版面带、青蓝扁平图示笔触（环绕弧、折光箭头、上升气流箭头）、拉丁 kicker 压中文主标、两栏发丝线规格表，光位统一为左上 40 度冷光，收口由 TRUST 改为 CTA，并新增 90 度正侧双联对比、高 65 度曝晒痛点与三色并列三镜。源图无任何佩戴镜，背影佩戴与空帽曝晒两镜为该品类通用延展设计并强制回避可识别面部。
